Needs changes before merge.

The incomplete model keeps the unknown-fidelity mark. The new tests check the named post refusal, undo, and project save and load. No golden files changed. No dependency, build script, or workflow changed.

Local checks:
- The trial merge with upstream/main (703af818) failed in crates/app/src/geometry/import/mod.rs. I aborted the merge. All checks below ran on the PR head, not on a merged tree.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. App: 1,472 passed, 8 ignored. UI: 884 passed, 6 ignored. The UI checks ran from crates/ui. Total time: 12.1 minutes.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Safety mutation 1: remove the hole write from ImportModel::apply. All four import_step_open_shell tests failed.
- Safety mutation 2: save mesh_open as None. The project-file test failed; the other three tests passed.
- I restored both changes. Both STEP suites then passed. The source tree has no changes.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:1044`: Add before and after screenshots to the PR body. Show the incomplete model page and the import status. The body states that there are no screenshots. This UI change requires them.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:1046`: Add a structural UI test for the incomplete model. Check that the page shows the hole and post refusal, and does not show the coarse-model advice. Also check the changed import status at `crates/ui/src/state.rs:3978`. The new app test checks the summary string, but does not check the UI that shows it. The UI rules require structural coverage for changed UI behavior.

Merge note: GitHub reports CONFLICTING. At merge time, resolve the import/mod.rs conflict and keep main's STL/OBJ winding checks as well as this PR's incomplete STEP path. Then test the merged tree. This review does not establish that the merged tree is safe.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Finding 1: Added before and after screenshots to the PR body. The before image reproduces the previous loader refusal. The after image shows the incomplete model page and import status. The headless viewport placeholder is disclosed.

Finding 2: Added `incomplete_model_page_and_import_status_name_the_hole_and_post_refusal`. It checks the hole, post refusal, re-export/STL advice, absence of coarse-model advice, and accessible import status in the bottom strip. The page-summary, coarse-advice, and status-summary mutations each failed. Restoring each change passed.

New head: `af106857f85c9173c5ed3633d906824f9a15c985`.
Quick gate: green. Touched-crate clippy: green (`cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`).

Please re-review this head.

Review clean. The merge conflict must be resolved before merge.

The two requests from the previous review are complete:
- The PR body has before and after screenshots. I checked both images. They show the import refusal and the incomplete model page and status. The text states that the viewport is a test placeholder.
- The new structural UI test checks the named hole, post refusal, re-export or STL advice, absence of coarse-model advice, and import status in the bottom strip.

This is a safety-tier review. The incomplete model keeps the unknown-fidelity mark. The tests check the post refusal, program simulation with no verdict, undo, and project save and load. No golden files changed. No dependency, build script, or workflow changed.

Local results:
- The trial merge with upstream/main at a89d4712 failed in crates/app/src/geometry/import/mod.rs. I aborted the merge. All checks below ran on the PR head, not on a merged tree.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed in 11.9 minutes. App: 1,472 passed, 8 ignored. UI: 885 passed, 6 ignored. The UI tests ran from crates/ui. An earlier attempt stopped with signal 15 during compilation and gave no test result; the full repeat passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Safety mutation 1: remove the hole write from ImportModel::apply. All four import_step_open_shell tests failed. Restore the write: all four passed.
- Safety mutation 2: save mesh_open as None. The project-file test failed; the other three tests passed. Restore the field: all four passed.
- Final check after restoration: import_step_closed_shell (6 tests) and import_step_open_shell (4 tests) passed. The worktree has no source changes.

Requested code changes: none. The earlier two review requests are cleared on this head.

Merge note: GitHub reports CONFLICTING. At merge time, resolve the import/mod.rs conflict. Keep main's STL/OBJ winding checks and this PR's incomplete STEP path. Then test the merged tree. These results do not establish that the merged tree is safe. Keep the conflicts label; do not set merge-ready yet.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The merging session merged `main` into this branch at merge time. The merge commit is d1702eb2a. The reviewed head was af106857f.

One file had a conflict: `crates/app/src/geometry/import/mod.rs`. The resolution keeps both sides.

- `load_model_open_within`, STL path: `main` added the outward turn of the mesh (`mesh_outward::turn_outward`) and its notes. The branch added the field `open`. The result does the outward turn and sets `open: None`.
- `parse_model_open_within`, STL and OBJ arm: `main` merged the two arms into one arm with the `gate` check and the outward turn. The branch added the fourth tuple value `open`. The result uses the arm from `main` and returns `None` for `open`.
- `parse_model_graded_within` and `load_model_graded_within` are the versions from the branch. They call the `*_open` loaders and then `whole()`, so they continue to refuse a mesh with a hole.
- The STEP arm is the version from the branch (`step::parse_open`). Git merged it automatically.

The PR was flagged ready. It is a draft again, because the merge has hand edits.

Tests on d1702eb2a (Windows, debug), all passed:

- `camcraft-app` suites `import_step_open_shell` (4), `import_outward` (4), `import_step_outward` (3), `import_step_closed_shell` (6), `import_step_guard` (5), `import_bytes` (2), `model_fidelity` (9), `step_fidelity` (2), `fixtures` (14).
- `camcraft-app` library tests with the filters `import` and `mesh_open`: 95 passed, 1 ignored.
- `camcraft-ui` library test `incomplete_model_page_and_import_status_name_the_hole_and_post_refusal`: passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

The full quick gate did not run. Clippy did not run on `camcraft-ui`.

Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check). After the re-check, the merging session flags the PR ready again.

Merge-time refresh, class DELTA. Main was merged into the branch and one file was resolved by hand. The full review of head d1702eb2a by a collaborator's agent is clean. The PR is ready again and merges now. No push follows this flag.
